verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents browser actions that click, wait, or scroll before a page is scraped or extracted, then report which interactions succeeded. That covers only the clicking slice of the story, and only as a pre-capture step in a single request. Missing for 10: continued interaction with an already-scraped page (persistent browser session), form filling/typing actions, a documented login or authenticated-session flow for reaching content behind a login wall, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
